    Send Signal node

    The Send Signal node is a render-free destination node. It receives one or more UI outputs and routes navigation through the Portal with the same Signal address. It does not display a View and has no output port.

    A Signal output ─┐
                 ├─> Send Signal (Home) ──lookup──> Portal (Home) ──> Home UI
B Time Delay ────┘

    Inspector and port

    Field Description
    Display Name Optional canvas title, for example Go To Home
    Node Description Authoring note
    Clear History Clears Back and Forward history when this destination is entered
    Address Type Database or Custom
    Database Signal Signal catalog Category / Key
    Custom Signal Case-sensitive graph-local string
    Enter Multi-capacity input; accepts Signal, Time Delay, and other UI transition outputs

    Connect existing UI outputs directly to Enter. Do not add a special Destinations output to the UI node. When an output reaches Send Signal, the runtime resolves the matching Signal Portal and executes that Portal's History and downstream route.

    The graph reports an error when the address is empty, the Enter input is unconnected, or no Signal Portal has the same address type and value.

    Important

    Send Signal is terminal in the visible wire flow. Its next route belongs to the matching Portal, not to an output on the Send Signal node.
